Calienta agua hasta que hierva. El cuscú: Heat water until it boils. Couscous is not boiled: it is soaked.
Calienta dos cucharadas de aceite en una: Heat two tablespoons of oil in a pan over a LOW heat. Pil-pil is made over a low heat or it is not made at all.
Calienta el arroz (chorrito de agua, tap: Warm the rice (a splash of water, covered, 1 minute), serve with the carrot and the pork. Pepper.
Calienta el arroz aparte con un chorrito: Warm the rice separately with a splash of water, covered, for 1 minute and serve it with the chicken on top, along with all its oil.
Calienta el arroz con un chorrito de agu: Warm the rice with a splash of water, covered, for 1 minute; mix it with the tomato.
Warm the rice with a splash of water; mix it with the cauliflower.
Calienta el arroz integral (chorrito de: Warm the brown rice (a splash of water, covered, 1 minute), mix it with the spinach and serve with the pork. Pepper.
Warm the brown rice (a splash of water, covered, 1 minute), mix it with the spinach.
Warm the brown rice (a splash of water, covered, 1 minute), mix it with the vegetables and serve with the meat.
Warm the brown rice (a splash of water, covered, 1 minute).
Calienta el arroz integral aparte con un: Warm the brown rice separately with a splash of water, covered, for 1 minute: it comes out drier than white.
Warm the brown rice separately with a little water, covered, for 1 minute.
Calienta el arroz integral con un chorri: Warm the brown rice with a splash of water, covered, for 1 minute (it comes out dry).
Warm the brown rice with a splash of water, covered, for 1 minute; mix it with the spinach.
Warm the brown rice with a splash of water, covered, for 1 minute; mix it with the vegetables.
Warm the brown rice with a splash of water, covered, for 1 minute.
Calienta el cuscús aparte: agua caliente: Warm the couscous separately: hot water over the top, covered for 2 minutes.
Calienta el cuscús: si es de sobre ya co: Warm the couscous: if it is the ready-cooked kind, a splash of hot water over the top and covered for 2 minutes.
Calienta el cuscús: un chorrito de agua: Warm the couscous: a splash of hot water, covered for 2 minutes, then fluff it up with a fork.
Calienta el trigo sarraceno (tiene sabor: Warm the buckwheat (it has a nutty flavour); separate the grains with a fork, do not mash it.
Calienta el trigo sarraceno y sepáralo c: Warm the buckwheat and separate the grains with a fork; mix it with the pepper.
Warm the buckwheat and separate the grains with a fork; mix it with the tempeh and the cauliflower. Pepper.
Warm the buckwheat and separate the grains with a fork; mix it with the carrot.
Warm the buckwheat and separate the grains with a fork; mix it through everything.
Warm the buckwheat and separate the grains with a fork.
Calienta el trigo sarraceno, sepáralo co: Warm the buckwheat, separate the grains with a fork and mix it with the pepper. Prawns on top. Lemon.
Calienta el wrap 10 segundos por lado en: Warm the wrap for 10 seconds a side in the pan or in the microwave: cold, it cracks when you fold it.
Calienta el wrap 20 segundos por cada la: Warm the wrap for 20 seconds a side in a dry pan. Cold, it breaks when you fold it.
Calienta la pasta con dos cucharadas de: Warm the pasta with two tablespoons of water; mix it with the broccoli.
Calienta la pasta ya cocida en la misma: Warm the cooked pasta in the same pan with two tablespoons of water, stirring for 1 minute.
Calienta la pasta ya cocida en la sartén: Warm the cooked pasta in the pan with two tablespoons of water, mixing it with the tomato for 1 minute.
Warm the cooked pasta in the pan with two tablespoons of water, mixing it with the vegetables for 1 minute.
Calienta la pasta ya cocida en un cazo o: Warm the cooked pasta in a pot or pan with a splash of water, 1 minute.
Calienta la quinoa con un chorrito de ag: Warm the quinoa with a splash of water and fluff it up with a fork.
Calienta la quinoa y ahuécala con un ten: Warm the quinoa and fluff it up with a fork; mix it with the vegetables.
Warm the quinoa and fluff it up with a fork; mix it with the mushrooms.
Warm the quinoa and fluff it up with a fork.
Calienta la quinoa, ahuécala con un tene: Warm the quinoa, fluff it up with a fork and let it cool a little too: hot, it would make the spinach watery.
Warm the quinoa, fluff it up with a fork and mix it with the vegetables and the chicken, along with all the juices from the tray.
Warm the quinoa, fluff it up with a fork and mix it with the vegetables and their juices. Serve with the turkey.
Warm the quinoa, fluff it up with a fork. Serve with the sliced breast and the broccoli. Salt, pepper, lemon and a drizzle of raw oil (no fat has been used up to this point).
Calienta la quinoa, mézclala con los cha: Warm the quinoa, mix it with the mushrooms and serve the monkfish on top. Salt at the end.
Calienta la quinoa; si está apelmazada,: Warm the quinoa; if it has clumped, a little water and fluff it up with a fork.
Calienta la sartén a fuego alto con una: Heat the pan over a high heat with a tablespoon of oil before adding the meat. In a cold pan it releases water and stews grey instead of browning.
Heat the pan over a high heat with a tablespoon of oil BEFORE adding the meat. In a cold pan it releases water and stews grey.
Calienta la sartén a fuego ALTO con una: Heat the pan over a HIGH heat with a tablespoon of oil until it shimmers.
Heat the pan over a HIGH heat with a tablespoon of oil until it smokes slightly. Sear the fillet for 2 minutes a side without moving it, for a piece about 3 cm thick.
Calienta la sartén a fuego alto con una: Heat the pan over a high heat with a tablespoon of oil and brown the chicken for 5 minutes, stirring only now and then so it actually browns.
Heat the pan over a high heat with a tablespoon of oil and brown the meat without touching it for the first minute.
Heat the pan over a high heat with a tablespoon of oil and add the mince WITHOUT stirring it for the first minute, so it browns underneath.
Heat the pan over a high heat with a tablespoon of oil and sear the medallions for 3 minutes a side without moving them.
Heat the pan over a high heat with a tablespoon of oil, until the oil shimmers.
Calienta la sartén a fuego BAJO con unas: Heat the pan over a LOW heat with a few drops of oil. High heat is the classic mistake: it sets the egg into dry lumps.
Heat the pan over a LOW heat with a few drops of oil. Whites on their own set and dry out faster than whole egg.
Calienta la sartén a fuego medio y úntal: Heat the pan over a medium heat and wipe it with a drop of oil spread around with kitchen paper. A pool of oil = a fried pancake, not a pancake.
Calienta la sartén a fuego medio-alto co: Heat the pan over a medium-high heat with a little oil until it smokes very slightly.
Heat the pan over a medium-high heat with a tablespoon of oil until it shimmers.
Heat the pan over a medium-high heat with a tablespoon of oil until the oil shimmers.
Heat the pan over a medium-high heat with a tablespoon of oil and brown the tempeh for 3 minutes a side, until it is properly golden.
Heat the pan over a medium-high heat with a tablespoon of oil and lay the salmon down SKIN SIDE DOWN.
Heat the pan over a medium-high heat with a tablespoon of oil and lay the burger down without touching it for 4 minutes.
Heat the pan over a medium-high heat with a teaspoon of oil.
Calienta la sartén a fuego MEDIO-BAJO y: Heat the pan over a MEDIUM-LOW heat and oil it well, the sides too: whites on their own stick far more than whole egg.
Calienta la sartén a fuego MUY alto con: Heat the pan over a VERY high heat with a tablespoon of oil, until the oil is on the point of smoking. Beef needs more heat than any other meat.
Heat the pan over a VERY high heat with a tablespoon of oil.
Heat the pan over a VERY high heat with a tablespoon of oil. Beef needs more heat than chicken.
Calienta la tortilla 20 segundos por cad: Warm the tortilla for 20 seconds a side in a dry pan: cold, it cracks when you fold it.
Calienta la tortilla 20 segundos por lad: Warm the tortilla for 20 seconds a side in a dry pan.
Calienta la tortilla de trigo 10 segundo: Warm the wheat tortilla for 10 seconds a side in a bare pan, or 10 seconds in the microwave. Cold, it cracks when you fold it; warm, it rolls without tearing.
Calienta la tortilla de trigo 20 segundo: Warm the wheat tortilla for 20 seconds a side in a dry pan, with no oil. Cold, it cracks when you fold it; warm, it folds without tearing.
Calienta los macarrones ya cocidos en la: Warm the cooked macaroni in the pan with two tablespoons of water, mixing it with the vegetables for 1 minute.
Calienta una sartén a fuego alto con una: Heat a pan over a high heat with a tablespoon of oil.
Calienta una sartén antiadherente a fueg: Heat a non-stick pan over a MEDIUM-LOW heat with a few drops of oil. Whites turn rubbery over a high heat: here patience is the technique.
Calienta una sartén con una cucharada de: Heat a pan with a tablespoon of oil over a high heat. Add the peppers and fry them for 6 minutes without moving them much, until they soften and take on dark patches. Those patches are flavour, not burning.
Heat a pan with a tablespoon of oil over a medium-high heat. Fry the cauliflower for 3 minutes so it picks up some colour, which is where the flavour is.
